evidence: Has P2P label and directly modifies Tor connection binding and peer handling.
rationale: Prevents Tor peers from being misclassified and inheriting IP-based whitelist permissions when automatic onion listening shares a generic bind. The PR description notes that without a dedicated bind, 'Tor peers arriving through shared or wildcard binds may be classified by IP and inherit address-based whitelist permissions', which poses an inbound permission bypass risk.
